title: agent skills / Skill locations
content:
## Skill locations Store project skills in the repository when you want to share them with contributors. Store personal skills in your home directory to use them across workspaces. Each skill has its own directory containing `SKILL.md`. The following table gives a supported project and personal location for each harness, not every directory it recognizes. The Agent Customizations editor offers creation locations for the selected harness. | Harness | Skill directories | |---------|-------------------| | {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} | Project: `.github/skills/`
Personal: `~/.copilot/skills/` | | {% data variables.product.prodname_anthropic_claude %} | Project: `.claude/skills/`
Personal: `~/.claude/skills/` | | {% data variables.product.prodname_openai_codex %} | Project: `.agents/skills/`
Personal: `~/.agents/skills/` | | Local | Project: `.github/skills/`
Personal: `~/.copilot/skills/` | ### Codex To reuse repository skills with {% data variables.product.prodname_openai_codex %}, [configure the experimental Codex integration](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md#codex). In addition to native `.agents/skills/` discovery, this integration discovers workspace skills in `.github/skills/` before your first prompt, without additional skill-location configuration. If skills in `.github/skills/` have duplicate names across workspace roots, the primary root takes precedence. The Codex harness is disabled when [{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} enterprise-managed settings apply](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#claude-and-codex-availability). Contact the IT team that deployed the settings to discuss access. ### Local Local sessions also read project skills from `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`, and personal skills from `~/.claude/skills/` and `~/.agents/skills/`. The deprecated `setting(chat.agentSkillsLocations)` setting adds other skill locations for Local sessions and remains available for compatibility. When another harness runs in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}, the editor forwards skills from these locations. Independent harness clients do not inherit this setting. To use these skills from native locations, [move them to supported locations](/docs/agent-customization/migrate-customizations.md#move-customizations-from-configured-locations). ### Monorepos If you open a subfolder of a monorepo, check the [parent repository discovery requirements](/docs/agent-customization/overview.md#use-customizations-in-a-monorepo) before storing skills above the open workspace folder.
